question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:

FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '25' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25
  AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-25';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
  AND (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-24' OR strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) = '02-29')
  AND (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-24' OR strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) = '02-29')
  AND (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) != '02-29' OR (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) % 4 = 0 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) % 100 != 0 OR CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) % 400 = 0)));

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
          OR (
              CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
              AND (
                  CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < 12
                  OR (
                      CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 12
                      AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 1
                  )
              )
          )
      )
      AND NOT (
          CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 > 2026
          OR (
              CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
              AND (
                  CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) > 12
                  OR (
                      CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 12
                      AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) > 1
                  )
              )
          )
      )
);

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
    (CASE WHEN 
      (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER)) OR 
      (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) AND 
       CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%d', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER)) 
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 25
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

       OR (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 25));
